error.reason: batch_check needs an API key; anonymous callers cannot use it. (A request without a key is not a call.)
error.what_counts: A call is one machine read of the Mdexa database content: an API data request, an MCP database tool call, or a download of a dataset .json/.md file or catalog.json. Web pages, sign-in, tools/list and requests that are rejected do not count (definition: GET /v1/tools, call_definition).
error.next_step: Without an account, datasets can be looked up by exact name: slugs=a,b,c in search_datasets or GET /v1/datasets (up to 50 per call). A free account provides an API key and batch_check for up to 10 items per call. Sign up: https://mdexa.com/signup/
error.for_your_user: Checking a whole list in one call needs an API key from a free account (no payment). Without one, the caller can still look datasets up by slug, up to 50 per call. Whether to sign up is the user's decision: https://mdexa.com/signup/
